newsitem.title: USA: Cubist hits Bristol-Myers pact milestones.
newsitem.headline: Cubist hits Bristol-Myers pact milestones.

text.p: Cubist Pharmaceuticals Inc said Thursday that it has achieved the second and third research milestones under its agreement with Bristol-Myers Squibb Co to develop and commercialize new antibacterial and antifungal pharmaceutical agents.

These milestones relate to Cubist successfully developing and transferring technology to Bristol-Myers to conduct high-throughput (rapid) screening of novel targets to identify new classes of potential drug leads.

In December, 1996 the two companies announced that they had entered into a research and licensing agreement with a potential value of $56 million and that Cubist had received its first milestone payment.
The milestone payment amounts were not disclosed.
Cubist said the focus of the collaboration is to develop novel drugs to treat bacterial and fungal infections including drug resistant microorganisms and tuberculosis.
